decisions.decision: Use AsyncLogParser::new(path).parse().await as the primary parsing API
decisions.rationale: User requirement: proper async-api pattern from dm-database-parser-sqllog 2.0.4

decisions.decision: AsyncError::Parse → log warn + return Ok((0, stats_with_parse_error)); do NOT propagate error up
decisions.rationale: File-level error: skip file with 0 records, continue processing remaining files. AsyncLogParser fails entire file on first bad record (no per-record error details). Tests already updated to expect no error log (test_watch_error_log_append asserts error log does NOT exist).

decisions.decision: For rayon parallel paths (parallel.rs, prescan.rs): capture tokio Handle BEFORE rayon, use block_in_place to wrap rayon work, then inside rayon closures call handle.block_on(AsyncLogParser::new(path).parse())
decisions.rationale: Cannot .await inside rayon threads. JoinSet requires Pipeline to be Clone which is complex. block_in_place + handle.block_on is the pragmatic approach for a CLI tool. Rayon threads are NOT async contexts so handle.block_on() is safe to call from them.

decisions.decision: process_sqlite_parallel stays as a sequential loop (not JoinSet) since SQLite writes are inherently serial
decisions.rationale: Already sequential — parse_and_write_sqlite just needs to become async

decisions.decision: Watch loop recv_timeout: wrap with tokio::task::block_in_place, trigger fns become async and use .await
decisions.rationale: recv_timeout is blocking, block_in_place signals to tokio to schedule other tasks while blocked
